subject: S15b: approve_generated(conn, item_id, admin_id, section_id, caption) is ready
body: In naadi_api/generation/approval.py: async approve_generated(conn, item_id: UUID, admin_id: UUID, section_id: str, caption: str, *, store=None, buckets=None, label=None) -> ApproveOut (item, media_id, section_id). conn = open service-role transaction with dict rows. store/bucket/label default from settings + models.yaml, so your call is just approve_generated(conn, item, admin, section, caption). Raises GenerationError(status, code) (naadi_api.generation.common): generated_not_found 404, generated_not_ready 409, generated_video_not_publishable 422 (only images are published), section_not_found 404 (student-owned chapters refused). Idempotent. Columns (status, error, paused_until, approved_by, approved_at, media_asset_id) arrive in my migration 0022 (down_revision = head at integrate). Pending list = ready, kind image, not approved_for_publish. My POST /api/admin/generated/{id}/approve stays as a thin wrapper until your queue replaces it; I will not touch your queue code. Your GateRefused 409 shape is fine with me: GenerationError uses the standard error shape too (generation.error.<code> copy).
